segments.text: I HAVE A MOTION FROM COUNCILMAN VIERA. I HAVE A SECOND FROM COUNCIL MEMBER CARLSON. DO I NEED TO ROLL CALL THIS?

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: YES, BECAUSE OF --

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: OKAY. ROLL CALL. VIERA?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: CHARLIE MIRANDA
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: THE CLERK
segments.text: THE MOTION PASSES UNANIMOUSLY WITH YOUNG AND CLENDENIN BEING ABSENT.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: THANK YOU SO MUCH. THAT CONCLUDES OUR REGULARLY SCHEDULED PROGRAM. DO WE HAVE ANY NEW BUSINESS TONIGHT? COUNCIL MEMBER CARLSON.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: JUST ONE. I'VE BEEN ASKED BY THE COMMUNITY TO PROVIDE AN OFF-SITE COMMENDATION FOR ASHLEY BUTLER, THE OWNER OF ICE COLD AIR DISCOUNT AUTO REPAIR IN RECOGNITION OF HER SERVICE TO THE CHILDREN AND FAMILIES IN THE TAMPA BAY REGION.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: I HAVE A MOTION FROM COUNCIL MEMBER CARLSON. SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: SECOND. IS THIS THE ONE ON DALE MABRY? YEAH, GREAT BUSINESS. WOMAN-OWNED BUSINESS AND ALWAYS VERY POSITIVE QUOTES. I LOVE DRIVING BY THERE, ALWAYS SOMETHING INSPIRING, AND THEY DO GREAT WORK.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: WONDERFUL. ALL IN FAVOR? AYE. OKAY. THAT'S ALL? COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO?

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: NO, I'M GOOD. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: COUNCILMAN MIRANDA?

segments.speaker: CHARLIE MIRANDA
segments.text: NONE.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: COUNCILMAN VIERA?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: YES, MA'AM. I HAVE A FEW, IF I MAY. PLEASE LET ME -- SEBASTIAN HAS THESE MOTIONS. I HAVE A FEW. I MOTION FOR AN IN-PERSON STAFF REPORT FEBRUARY NEXT YEAR, WRITTEN REPORT ADDRESS CONCERNS THEREIN. FOLLOWING UP ON THE WORK THAT HE DID, THAT WE GOT THE MEMO ON.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: WHAT IS THIS ABOUT?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: I'M SORRY. TOM DEGEORGE, IF YOU REMEMBER, THE SMALLER CONCERT VENUE SITES IN YBOR CITY.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: SECOND.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: MOTION FROM COUNCILMAN VIERA. SEBASTIAN, IF SEBASTIAN COULD COME AND BRING THE WRITTEN REPORTS, THAT WOULD BE HANDY.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: YEAH.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: THIS IS A MOTION TO -- IN-PERSON STAFF REPORT ABOUT MUSIC VENUES.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: SMALLER MUSIC VENUES IN YBOR CITY AND TO ADDRESS THE CONCERNS --

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: TO ADDRESS THE CONCERNS ABOUT SMALL MUSIC VENUES IN YBOR CITY, AND THAT'S GOING TO BE ON FEBRUARY 1st.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THERE IS NO MEETING. IT'S FEBRUARY 4.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: FEBRUARY 4. SORRY. SO I HAVE A MOTION AND A SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO. ALL THOSE IN FAVOR? AYE. OKAY. NEXT.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: THANK YOU. I MOTION, THE LAW FIRM OF BUSH ROSS IS HAVING THEIR 45th ANNIVERSARY, AND FOR ALL THEIR WORK IN THE COMMUNITY, I WANTED TO GIVE THEM A TAMPA CITY COUNCIL COMMENDATION, IF I MAY.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: MOTION FROM COUNCILMAN VIERA. SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO. ALL THOSE IN FAVOR? AYE. ANY OPPOSED?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: THEN COUNCILMAN CLENDENIN WAS HERE FOR THIS. BUT THERE IS AN ORGANIZATION CALLED THE WATTAKA, W-A-T-T-A-K-A. THEY ARE A CHORAL GROUP OF VENEZUELAN AMERICANS WHO SING AND WORK IN TAMPA CITY BALLET AND DIFFERENT ORGANIZATIONS. I WANTED TO GIVE WATTAKA VENEZUELAN CHORAL GROUP AND THEIR FOUNDER ASTRID SANCHEZ A TAMPA CITY COUNCIL COMMENDATION FOR ALL THE AMAZING WORK THEY DO IN TAMPA AND IN THE ARTS AND IN THE HISPANIC COMMUNITY.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: MOTION FROM VIERA. SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO. IS IT AN OFF-SITE COMMENDATION?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: OH, YEAH. ALL THESE ARE OFF-SITE.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: YES. ALL IN FAVOR? AYE.

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: THE LAST ONE -- I MENTIONED THIS A FEW WEEKS AGO. DAVID MECHANIK IS TAKING A BACK ROLE IN HART AND MANY OTHER THINGS. ALL OF US KNOW DAVID MECHANIK, HIS WORK ON THE TPO, HART, JUST AN AMAZING CITIZEN LAWYER. I WANTED TO GIVE HIM OFF-SITE, IF I MAY, TAMPA CITY COUNCIL COMMENDATION.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: COMMENDATION FOR DAVID MECHANIK FROM COUNCILMAN VIERA. SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO. ALL THOSE IN FAVOR? AYE. ANY OPPOSED?

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: THAT'S IT. THANK YOU, COUNCIL.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: WONDERFUL. DO I HAVE A MOTION TO RECEIVE AND FILE?

segments.speaker: CHARLIE MIRANDA
segments.text: MAKE A MOTION TO PRESENT A COMMENDATION -- [INAUDIBLE] [ LAUGHTER ]

segments.speaker: LUIS VIERA
segments.text: I'M STEALING THE SILVERWARE ON THE WAY OUT.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: GOOD, GOOD, GOOD. NO, I DON'T HAVE ANYTHING. MOTION TO RECEIVE AND FILE BY COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO, SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MIRANDA. ALL THOSE IN FAVOR? AYE. WE ARE ADJOURNED.
